personality_one_liner: A universally simple, Apple-grade utility that feels invisible until you need it—designed for instant trust and seamless transfers.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for content separation. Avoid dense dashboards; utilize whitespace to emphasize active transfers and paired devices.

do's: Use heavy glass on bottom tab bar and sticky headers to layer over the transfer lists.
Use glass for floating toolbars in Smart Board mode.
Use frosted glass overlays on top of the abstract radar texture in the Send/Pairing screen.
dont's: Do not blur standard list rows or form inputs.
Do not use transparent glass over high-contrast scrolling text without a strong surface tint.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A launchpad showing active/nearby devices and immediate quick-actions to send or receive.

states.empty: Illustration of a radar with 'Waiting for nearby devices...'
states.error: Error toast with a retry button

screens.layout: Sticky glass header. Top section features two prominent, side-by-side (or stacked) hero action cards: 'Send' and 'Receive' with subtle brand gradients. Below, a horizontal scrolling list of 'Nearby Devices' (using device icons in brandTertiary circles). Followed by a vertical list of 'Recent Transfers' showing file icons, names, and progress/completion status.

screens.name: Send (Pairing)
screens.purpose: Discovers and pairs with devices via QR scanner, 6-digit code, or proximity radar.

states.error: Failed to connect alert, retry CTA

screens.layout: Fullscreen immersive screen. Background uses the abstract glassmorphism texture. Top half is a camera viewfinder/QR scanner. A prominent bottom sheet (Glass) houses a 6-digit code input field and a grid of discovered nearby devices to tap and send.

screens.name: Receive
screens.purpose: Displays QR/Code for others to connect and monitors incoming file queues.

states.empty: No active transfers. 'Share your code above to receive files.'

screens.layout: Large central surfaceSecondary card containing the QR code and large, mono-spaced 6-digit PIN. Below the card, an 'Incoming Transfers' queue showing stacked list items with inline loading progress rings and cancel/pause buttons.

screens.name: Files (Inbox)
screens.purpose: Built-in file manager to browse, preview, and organize received files.

states.empty: Empty desk image. 'No files received yet.'

screens.layout: Glass sticky header with search bar and horizontal filter chips (All, Images, PDFs, Docs, Tags). Below is a 2-column grid or list view of files with thumbnails. Tap to open in full-screen preview. Floating Action Button (FAB) in brandPrimary for 'New Folder'.

screens.name: Smart Board (Presentation Mode)
screens.purpose: A collaborative, distraction-free canvas for presenting and annotating files.
screens.layout: Landscape/Fullscreen immersive view (no standard navigation). The main file (PDF/Image/Whiteboard) takes up the full canvas. A floating, draggable glass toolbar houses annotation tools (Pen, Highlighter, Eraser, Laser Pointer). A collapsible glass thumbnail strip on the bottom or side allows quick slide navigation. Pinned content cards can float on the board like a Pinterest workspace.

radar_abstract_background.alt: abstract glassmorphism texture for send screen background

empty_inbox.alt: clean empty organized desk for empty file manager state

smart_board_empty.alt: empty smart board in meeting room

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided; NO blues or purples are allowed. Use the Emerald Green brand color for primary actions.
Implement high-quality glassmorphism using 'expo-blur' on bottom tab bars, sticky headers, and floating annotation toolbars in Smart Board mode.
Ensure 'Smart Board' mode behaves responsively on tablets and web, prioritizing fullscreen canvas rendering with floating, draggable glass toolbars.
Apply 'radar_abstract_background' to the 'Send (Pairing)' screen as a full-bleed background, with a dark-to-transparent scrim overlay so UI text remains highly legible.
Build a robust transfer queue UI with clear progress indicators (rings or bars) and inline pause/cancel actions, mirroring Apple's AirDrop elegance.
Enforce iOS-native spacing and component sizing: 44x44pt minimum touch targets, generous lg/xl screen padding, and smooth React Native Reanimated transitions between states.
